name: effect-runtime-1673
scope: Isolated fixture pack on a copied checkout; manually prepared armor stands, a cow for core tick, and a protocol player. Actual give/remove/get, Effect callbacks, one normal core tick, stored actionbar message. Not normal login, real combat or rendered UI. Tests include re-give/remove order, clear filters/count, owner isolation, inheritance, legacy revision and milk/death.
